comments.author: DudeWithASweater
comments.body:
If you're doing the "I only need $1k a month, now let's backwards napkin math our way to figure out how to make exactly that amount every month" you're most likely already not going to succeed to be honest. You're coming at it from the wrong reasons.

Make good games and people will play them.

Just start and try it out, if you think it's a good idea, go for it. No one can answer your question because we're not you. We don't have your vision, your drive, your work ethic, your game design, etc. and maybe you can't make it work, but someone else could. Or maybe no one else could do it, but you can. That's the beauty of creating things.

Try it out, prototype your idea, see if it's fun/if it has potential. If it doesn't, scrap it, move on to the next. You'll likely have learned a lot from your trial and errors and you take that learning to the next thing. And the next. And the next.
